title: Joker
about: A struggling party clown in 1981 Gotham slowly comes apart.
cue: Serve the snacks when Arthur and his mum settle in front of the late-night talk show.
faces: CASH AT THE DOOR. NO QUESTIONS
“He's got a book. A book of jokes. Take your time. We've got all night.”
Popcorn coated in brown sugar and golden syrup caramel.
Cucumber spears pickled in vinegar with dill and garlic.
Beef meatloaf, tomato glaze. "You need to eat.".
Green room roast beef on rye
The talk show where Arthur is finally invited.
Green apples in hard sugar. "Put on a happy face.".
Bourbon, sweet vermouth and bitters stirred ice cold.

Two drink minimum at the stage tables. Cover charge after nine. No discussing Arthur's joke notebook at the tables. Card No. 2019. Showtime: Serve the snacks when Arthur and his mum settle in front of the late-night talk show.

    StartersLate-night TV salted caramel popcornPopcorn coated in brown sugar and golden syrup caramelHow to make it100g popcorn kernels2 tbsp vegetable oil100g butter200g brown sugar60ml golden syrup1/2 tsp bicarb soda1 tsp sea salt flakesPop the kernels in the oil in a covered pot.Melt the butter with the sugar and golden syrup and boil, then take off the heat and stir in the bicarb soda and salt.Pour over the popcorn and stir to coat.Spread on lined trays and bake at 120°C, stirring twice.Cool and break up.Gotham deli picklesCucumber spears pickled in vinegar with dill and garlicHow to make it4 Lebanese cucumbers, cut into spears1 bunch dill4 garlic cloves, sliced250ml white vinegar250ml water1 tbsp salt1 tbsp sugar1 packet rye crispbreadPack the cucumbers into a jar with dill and garlic.Heat the vinegar with the water, salt and sugar and pour over.Chill overnight.Serve in the jar with rye crispbread alongside.MainsDiner meatloafBeef meatloaf, tomato glaze. "You need to eat."How to make it800g beef mince1 brown onion, grated1 cup breadcrumbs1 egg1 tsp salt100ml tomato sauce1 tbsp brown sugar1kg potatoes50g butter500g frozen peasMix the mince with the onion, breadcrumbs, egg and salt and press into a loaf tin.Spread with tomato sauce mixed with brown sugar.Bake at 180°C.Boil and mash the potatoes with butter and cook the peas.Serve thick slices with mash and peas.Green room roast beef on ryeThe talk show where Arthur is finally invitedHow to make itAs written, serves 4Rare roast beef piled on rye with horseradish cream, pickles and crisp lettuce, cut in halves and stacked on a backstage platter.Season a 800g beef topside, sear all over and roast at 200°C for 30 minutes for rare.Rest, cool and slice thinly.Mix 150g sour cream with 2 tbsp horseradish, a squeeze of lemon and salt.Spread 8 slices of rye with the horseradish cream, then layer 4 with beef, sliced dill pickles and lettuce.Top with the other slices, cut in half and stack on a platter.SweetsHappy's candy applesGreen apples in hard sugar. "Put on a happy face."How to make it6 green apples6 wooden sticks400g caster sugar125ml water1 tbsp white vinegar1/2 tsp red food colouringWash and dry the apples well, remove the stalks and push in sticks.Heat the sugar, water and vinegar until dissolved, then boil without stirring until 150°C on a thermometer.Add the colouring and swirl.Tilt the pan and dip each apple, twisting to coat.Stand on baking paper to set.DrinksBourbon ManhattanBourbon, sweet vermouth and bitters stirred ice coldHow to make it240ml bourbon80ml sweet vermouth4 dashes of bitters4 maraschino cherries1 orange1 bag iceChill coupe glasses in the freezer.Fill a jug with ice and add bourbon, vermouth and bitters, then stir steadily until very cold.Strain into the glasses, drop in a cherry and twist a strip of orange peel over the top.
